# Timer:audioActions

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.0</span></div>

Get / Set the audio actions of the timer.

```lua
timer:audioActions([actions])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `actions` | table | optional |  |

## Returns

audio actions (table)

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
timer = model.getTimer(0)
timer:audioActions({
    {type=COUNTDOWN_VALUE, start=10, step=30},
    {type=COUNTDOWN_BEEP, start=11, step=31},
    {type=PLAY_FILE, start=12, step=32, filename="test.wav"},
    {type=PLAY_VALUE, start=13, step=30},
})
local audioActions = timer:audioActions()
```
